summary: Make this a flexible, self-guided comparison of northern Thai coffee rather than a café checklist: taste a named Thai origin as filter at Akha Ama Phrasingh in the Old City, then compare espresso or a signature drink at GRAPH One Nimman and Ristr8to in Nimman. The Chiang Mai Brief describes Nimman as the city's densest specialty-café cluster. Ask each barista what origin and process are actually on offer; menus and beans rotate.
whyGo: Compare northern-grown Arabica and brewing styles across a producer-led café and two established Nimman bars.
Pair an Old City stop with temples, then continue to a compact café cluster rather than planning a coffee-only day.
Buy a small bag of a cup you enjoyed; local 250 g bags are commonly around ฿300–600, with premium lots higher.
bestFor: Coffee drinkers curious about Thai origins, processing and roast profiles
Independent visitors wanting an easy half-day with flexible stops
People looking for locally roasted beans to take home
skipIf: You expect a guided tasting, roastery tour or farm visit; these café visits do not include one.
You want a quiet or uncaffeinated outing; Nimman can be busy and decaf availability is unconfirmed.
You need verified step-free access at every stop; branch-level access details were not found.
duration: Allow 2–3 hours including travel between the Old City and Nimman; this is a planning estimate for three short visits. Shorten it to one neighborhood if you prefer an unhurried tasting.
cost: No crawl ticket or admission fee. Budget roughly ฿60–180 per drink, depending on brew method and bean, based on a September 2026 Chiang Mai café guide; three drinks would be about ฿180–540 before snacks and transport. Local 250 g bean bags are commonly about ฿300–600. These are indicative ranges, not guaranteed December 2026 menus.
hours: Akha Ama Phrasingh currently lists daily 08:00–17:30. GRAPH One Nimman lists 11:00–22:00; One Nimman's own directory gives the complex hours as 11:00–21:00, so confirm the café's hours locally. Ristr8to listings conflict: TAT says 07:00–18:00 daily while other current listings differ, including Wednesday closure. Check the exact branch before setting out; holiday hours are not yet known.
bestTime: Start in the morning at Akha Ama, then go to Nimman after 11:00 when GRAPH One Nimman opens. Order a filter coffee to compare the bean clearly, then an espresso or signature drink at the next stop. December is a comfortable season for walking, but allow for busy cafés and traffic.
gettingThere: Akha Ama Phrasingh is near Wat Phra Singh in the Old City. From there, take a songthaew, taxi or ride-hail to Nimman (roughly 10–20 minutes is a traffic-dependent planning estimate), then walk between GRAPH One Nimman and Ristr8to. The Old City and Nimman are separate neighborhoods; do not plan to walk the whole route. Use map pins for the named branches, since café brands have multiple locations.
booking: Ordinary café visits are walk-in; no reservation requirement was found. A drink purchase does not include a formal tasting, roasting session or farm visit. Ask the café directly about any special experience and current single-origin selection.
accessibility: Step-free entrances, accessible toilets and seating at the named branches were not confirmed. GRAPH is inside the One Nimman complex, but that does not verify café-counter or toilet access. Sidewalks and crossings between Nimman cafés can be uneven or interrupted; contact venues ahead if access needs are important.
practicalTips: Ask ‘Which Thai origin is on filter today?’ and whether it is washed, honey or natural processed; current lots rotate.
Choose one drink at each stop and drink water between tastings; several espresso drinks add up quickly.
Akha Ama Phrasingh is the branch with published daily hours; its other locations have different schedules.
Confirm current hours and menu prices directly shortly before visiting, especially around holidays.
decemberNotes: No December 2026 coffee event, special menu or holiday schedule was verified. Northern Thailand's harvest period varies by growing area and elevation, and a fresh harvest is not assured at city cafés; ask whether a featured lot is from the current crop. Recheck opening hours and the beans on offer shortly before the visit.
uncertainties: Ristr8to's published opening schedules conflict; confirm directly, especially on Wednesday.
December 2026 branch hours, prices, crowd levels and single-origin menus may change.
The cited photo is a general Akha Ama café reference and does not identify a branch; reuse permission is not established.
Accessibility, decaf, plant-milk options and allergy procedures were not verified.
